Improved Heroic Strike.text: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 1 Rage.

Improved Rend.text: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 12%.

Improved Charge.text: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 3.

Improved Tactical Mastery.text: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 3 Rage when you change stances.

Improved Overpower.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%.

Anger Management.text: Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.

Deep Wounds.text: Your critical strikes cause your opponent to Bleed, dealing 20% of your melee weapon's average damage over 12 sec.

Spearing Strike.text: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage, plus an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets.

Two-Handed Weapon Specialization.text: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 1%.

Impale.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 10%.

Bloodthrill.text: Your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend have a 4% chance to allow the use of your Overpower ability on the target. Lasts 6 sec.

Sweeping Strikes.text: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

Weaponmaster.text: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.   Axe/Polearm: Increases your  critical strike chance by 1%.   Mace/Staff: Your attacks ignore  3% of your target's armor.   Sword: Your successful melee

Improved Slam.text: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.25 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3.0 sec.

Improved Hamstring.text: Gives your Hamstring ability a 5% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

Mortal Strike.text: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

Booming Voice.text: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by 10% and reduces their Rage cost by 5%.

Cruelty.text: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 1%.

Lingering Rage.text: Increases the time before your Rage begins to decay after leaving combat by 2 sec.

Unbridled Wrath.text: Gives you a 12% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

Furious Precision.text: Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 4%.

Piercing Howl.text: Causes all enemies within 10 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

Blood Craze.text: Regenerates 1% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

Dual Wield Specialization.text: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 5% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by 10%.

Raging Blows.text: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave and Whirlwind abilities by 3.

Enrage.text: Gives you a 30% chance to deal 2% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.

Improved Execute.text: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by 3.

Improved Berserker Rage.text: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 5 Rage and has a 50% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.

Death Wish.text: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

Improved Intercept.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 5 sec.

Flurry.text: Increases your melee attack speed by 5% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

Gore Drinker.text: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 0.5% of your maximum Health.

Bloodthirst.text: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

Improved Bloodrage.text: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 25%.

Shield Specialization.text: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 1% and grants you a 20% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.

Iron Will.text: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 3%.

Improved Revenge.text: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 20%.

Improved Thunder Clap.text: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 2.

Last Stand.text: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

Master of Defense.text: Grants you a 50% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped.

Improved Disarm.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 7 secs.

Defiance.text: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 5% while a shield is equipped.

Improved Sunder Armor.text: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor ability by 1.

Vanguard.text: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.

Improved Shield Bash.text: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 50% chance to Silence the target for 3 sec.

Improved Shield Wall.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall ability by 5.5 min.

Focused Rage.text: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by 1.

Bastion.text: Increases all damage you deal by 2% while a shield is equipped.

Shield Slam.text: Slam the target with your shield, causing 421 to 439 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.
